theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_ga_det_id_add_adjoint_comp_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (B : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ‖B‖ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B).det ∧ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B).det ≤ 1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖B (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
